medium: Create one breathtaking WIDESCREEN 16:9 theatrical animation keyframe, full bleed edge-to-edge without text, border, words or panels. For an original Japanese animated music film THE SEA FALLS UP. Traditional hand-painted cel-film art direction: lush gouache backgrounds, elegant graphite contour lines, scratched pigment textures, subtle analog grain. Moody petrol-blue and indigo ocean, eucalyptus teal in water, ivory sea foam, accents of cinnabar orange and warm amber light. Graphic, painterly and cinematic like a fine art print pulled from a lost science-fiction animation film. Strong tonal separation, beautifully drawn organic shapes; avoid glossy CGI, icons, typography, generic concept art. Protect important subjects within central 75% of frame for a widescreen crop.

frames.coast: Extreme wide establishing shot from water level at blue hour. A single old ivory cylindrical lighthouse with a narrow dark iron lantern gallery and amber glass lantern, rust-red cap, on a black basalt islet, positioned on the RIGHT at approximately x=.74. A sloping breakwater and anatomically convincing wavelets fill the lower quarter. Massive quiet indigo sky and far offshore clouds on the LEFT with generous quiet negative space for a later film title. A faint line of peach at horizon. Unexpected diagonal waves at the bottom giving depth. No visible people. The lantern is a small amber point, do not paint a long beam, our animation will add it.
frames.keeper: Intimate medium profile inside a coastal lighthouse lantern room at night. A young adult Japanese woman, chin-length straight black bob with blunt bangs, ocher-orange hooded fisherman raincoat with hood down, leans over an old brass signal desk. Her fingers rest on an antique telegraph key, she gazes left toward the sea beyond tall rain-streaked glass. Her face beautifully drawn in quite subtle expressive profile in the RIGHT half. Large geometric indigo window panes on the left, amber light brushes her nose, jacket and fingertips. Moody film frame, thoughtful, confident brush contours, no cables crossing the face, no lettering.
frames.key: Extreme macro insert of a lighthouse keeper's warm human fingertips pressing the dark ebonite knob of an antique brass Morse telegraph key. The bent metal lever is a strong diagonal, copper screw and coil in focus. A glimpse of saffron-orange oilskin cuff in upper right. On a very dark scratched mahogany desk, luminous amber glass reflections at left, shadowy deep-teal blur behind. Extremely tactile, selective focus and restrained chiaroscuro, assertive asymmetric composition. No labels or legible text.
frames.drop: The strange first sign that gravity has changed. Extreme low angle inches above midnight seawater. ONE flawless fist-sized spherical droplet hangs suspended around the CENTER in a dark blue sky, with a tiny upside-down ivory lighthouse mirrored INSIDE it and a sliver of amber specular shine. Smaller glistening vertical beads rising below it. Quiet shallow depth of field, hazy pink line at horizon and rippling indigo water across lower third. A truly patient, iconic close-up; fine hand-painted liquid refraction, delicate drawn lines. No person.
frames.rising: From a low camera at the base of a lighthouse, an entire sheet of turquoise ocean is pouring UP into the sky in an immense sweeping inverted waterfall shaped like a fabric curtain. The water forms a dramatic hanging arc from upper left to top right, silver foam and intricately etched wave veins. An old ivory lighthouse, its red roof and amber lantern intact, very small near the lower right with basalt and a postage-stamp orange figure. Pale coral horizon between the ocean floor and the raised ocean, strong scale and powerful upward motion. Single unified frame, magnificent improbable geography.
frames.whale: A great humpback whale has risen with the sea, suspended IN THE OPEN SKY. Ultra-wide worm's-eye composition from a tiny lighthouse balcony; the whale's magnificent indigo back and pearl-gold striated belly sweep diagonally across the TOP two thirds, head to the LEFT, lobed flippers, white barnacles, long fluke tapering to the RIGHT. Tiny ivory lighthouse roof and red-orange speck low right establish unbelievable scale. Peach dawn, indigo mountains of cloud, arcs of silver water shed off the whale. Emotionally triumphant, really beautiful details on the cetacean underside, incandescent rim light. The whale is fully visually dominant.
frames.eye: An intimate extreme close-up of the face of a huge humpback whale seen from the side. One dark still eye sits around x=.57 y=.48, framed by wet indigo skin and patinated silver barnacles, textured pale ocher marks, curves like the topography of an old map. In the shiny eye, a TINY reflection of an orange-jacketed lighthouse keeper standing on a balcony with a warm lantern. Keep skin organic and naturally cetacean, quiet and tender, lovely amber light at an oblique angle. Close enough that the whole frame is filled with this face, no horizon.
frames.shoal: An upward view from within the inverted sea: a spiral of many beautiful slender silver sardines carves a wide twisting aperture through transparent dark teal water, a very pale amber sun on the far side around x=.58 y=.38. Fishes in foreground big and anatomically elegant, distant fish reduced to flecks. Dense detailed forms around the periphery, a beautifully open glowing center, alternating bands of turquoise and deep sapphire, light shafts refracted through suspended waves. Painterly, graphic, transporting.
frames.balcony: In a quiet moment the adult young Japanese lighthouse keeper in her ocher-orange rain parka, chin-length black bob and blunt fringe, stands in three-quarter back/profile view in the LEFT foreground on a weathered iron lighthouse balcony. Hair and collar caught in a sea wind. She looks out toward the astonishing ceiling of an inverted ocean over a pale lavender and warm apricot dawn. A single fine horizon is in the lower distance, reflections under the cloud-ocean. A gentle surrender in her face. Japanese animation frame with soft gouache atmosphere. No other people.
frames.return: Sunrise climax of an original animated film. Wide aerial profile above the cloud bank. A grand humpback whale and a small calf swim leftward in the SKY, their flippers elegantly splayed and glistening, broad tails disappearing to right. Warm vermilion sun very low on the LEFT, pink and apricot sky, indigo and plum shadows, distant ocean below and fan-shaped towers of water reaching up. A tiny old ivory lighthouse with rust-red cap far below at lower center right. The richest golden rim light; overwhelming sense of freedom and reunion, with anatomically convincing whales and balanced open space. Filmic paint texture, not a greeting card.
frames.dawn: After the sea has come home, an absolutely still wide dawn seascape. View across an old dark iron balcony railing in the LOWER LEFT foreground, where a short weathered vermilion-orange ribbon is tied in a knot and lifts gently in the breeze. The horizon is level, a dark low basalt rock out far to sea, calm blue-and-peach ripples below, pale apricot sunlight creeping from the right, enormous pale cream and lavender morning sky, cloud edges dissolve in sunlight. Restrained, empty, quietly hopeful painterly frame. No people, no whales, no buildings or lettering. Railing and orange knot on far left, open center and right for later credits.
